title: The Copper Creek
text: A creek runs green over copper stones, the water bright and bitter, the banks stained the colour of verdigris. Nothing drinks here. Nothing grows. It would be easy pickings, if you do not mind your hands turning green for a week.

options.label: Pan the bitter creek, and never mind the green hands.

outcomes.text: The haul is good. Your hands stay green for a week, along with a bitter taste that will not leave.

options.label: The strongest dams it to dig the bed, and takes everything it holds.

outcomes.text: The haul is great. The village below runs dry and will curse your name for a generation.

options.label: Trace the creek to its source, where the copper runs thickest.

outcomes.text: At the source lies a rich vein. Something guards it, grown green and bitter too.
